text:
maya: Observed a ~3x spike in fncall schema rejects across eu-west and us-west in last 15m. Seems correlated with the strict-schema rollout (v1.8.2). sample logs:
```
WARN validate: toolhook_response rejected: missing 'result' key
trace: fncall.validate -> schema_check -> reject
route: model-variant-v2 -> strict-validator
```
Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:

jeff: yup, saw same. Rejects are mostly tool responses that include an extra wrapper array. Not sure if model behavior changed or adapter started returning brackets.

karen: is routing sending these to strict-validate for all tiers? We expected canary slice to be small. @karen checking routing policy now.

deploy-bot: canary rollout v1.8.2 -> 25% traffic (us-west, eu-west) :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

maya: looks like policy routed by model-variant tag + region -> strict. It's hitting some high-volume endpoints. Quota meters are counting these as billed fncall failures — we need to clarify billing semantics.

nate: we should avoid charging customers for schema rejects by default. Can we mark these as 'validation' not 'consumed tokens' in billing pipeline? Current product/finance rules treat fncall as unit when any response issued.

linda: also UX issue — console only shows aggregated 'rejects' but not route or validator version. link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/schema-rejects shows spike but no routing dim.

jeff: quick mitigation idea: add soft-validate mode that coerces array->{object} for toolhook outputs, for 5% fallback. Then surface soft->strict delta in dashboard.

karen: agree. But we need telemetry to capture 'coercion applied' vs 'strict reject' counts. otherwise rollouts won't be debuggable.

maya: proposed action items:
1) ops: flip strict-rollout from 25% -> 5% in eu-west/us-west (jeff)
2) eng-runtime: implement soft-coercion patch and flag telemetry (nate)
3) product: update billing rule for schema-rejects to non-billable while in canary (linda)

jeff: i'll open a tiny patch: if tool_hook returns [{...}] and schema expects object -> unwrap single-element array. feature flag soft_coerce_toolhook = true

nate: remember to add unit test for array-unwrapping and a metric: toolhook.coercion.count

linda: can we also add a console filter to break down rejects by route_id, validator_version, and coercion_applied? that'll make canary decisions easier.

maya: yes please. Add a short-term dashboard card with those dimensions. i'm also adding a sampling hook to capture raw payloads for 1% of rejects for triage (redacted PII).

deploy-bot: ticket created: INF-4321 'soft-coerce toolhook array->object, telemetry + dashboard card' assigned jeff,nate,linda (ETA 48h)

jeff: y'all ok with me throttling strict validator rollout to 5% now?

karen: yes do it.

nate: +1

linda: +1

maya: thanks, will monitor. if rejects drop we keep soft_coerce until rollout completes. :thumbsup:
